name: How long does the ADU construction process usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the ADU construction process usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for ADU construction varies, but a typical project from design to completion can take anywhere from 6 to 12 months. This includes several phases: initial consultation and design (1-2 months), permitting and approvals (2-4 months, depending on city processes), and actual construction (3-6 months). Factors like the complexity of the design, material availability, and weather can influence the overall duration. We work to streamline each phase for efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: The ADU construction process usually takes 6 to 12 months, encompassing design, permitting, and physical construction phases.
